palette: Blue-black metal, charcoal planes, and narrow cold-silver cutting edges.
valueRange: Predominantly dark with sharp, deliberate highlight control.
surfaceAndWear: Dense satin-black finish, crisp polish at edges, subtle grind pattern, almost no oxidation.
constructionVocabulary: Bold cutouts, angular guards, blackened plate overlaps, hooked accents, exact fittings.
supernaturalBehavior: Absorbs ambient light slightly in recesses; no aura or full-object glow.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Black leather, dark hardwood, charcoal textile, and tiny silver pins.
neighborDifference: Darker, bolder, and more ominously shaped than Steel; less airy and luminous than Skyiron.
